notes: This configuration file defines deterministic GST treatment for goods (HSN) and services (SAC) under Indian GST law.
ITC rules align with Section 16 and blocked credit provisions under Section 17(5) of the CGST Act.
Exempt goods and services are treated as GST 0 percent with ITC not applicable.
Rules must be reviewed against the latest GST Council notifications before every major version update.

itc_conditions: ITC is blocked under Section 17(5) of the CGST Act for motor vehicles used for transportation of persons with seating capacity up to 13, including the driver.
ITC may be allowed only if the vehicle is used for further supply of vehicles, transportation of passengers, or imparting driving training.
8703.description: Motor cars and other motor vehicles principally designed for the transport of persons.

itc_conditions: Recipient must be a registered taxable person.
Goods must be used in the course or furtherance of business for making taxable outward supplies.
3004.description: Medicaments consisting of mixed or unmixed products for therapeutic or prophylactic use.

itc_conditions: No ITC is available on inputs used exclusively for exempt supplies as per show-cause provisions under Section 17(2).
1001.description: Wheat and meslin supplied as exempt food grains.

itc_conditions: ITC is available when services are used in the course or furtherance of business.
Recipient must possess a valid tax invoice and satisfy conditions under Section 16 of the CGST Act.
special_notes: Includes professional, technical, consulting, IT and software-related services.
This rule assumes domestic taxable supplies; export of services may be zero-rated under separate provisions.

itc_conditions: ITC eligibility depends on specific notification conditions and is generally restricted for passenger transport services.
special_notes: Includes passenger transport services and other notified transport activities.

itc_conditions: Healthcare services provided by clinical establishments and authorized medical practitioners are exempt under GST.
ITC on inputs and input services used exclusively for exempt healthcare services is not available.
special_notes: Includes core healthcare services supplied by hospitals, clinics and licensed practitioners.
Any ancillary taxable services must be classified separately under applicable SAC codes.

notes: Applied when the HSN or SAC code is syntactically valid but not present in the rule configuration.
No automatic GST or ITC decision should be taken.
Applied when code_type is specified but the code value is missing or blank.
Transaction must be flagged for manual correction.
Applied when the code format fails validation rules.
Transaction must be treated as a data quality issue and routed to human review.

hsn_code.description: HSN codes must be numeric and 2, 4, 6 or 8 digits long.

sac_code.description: SAC codes must be numeric and 4 or 6 digits long.

rules: If code_type is HSN, the code must satisfy HSN validation rules.
If code_type is SAC, the code must satisfy SAC validation rules.
GST slab values must belong to allowed_gst_slabs.
itc_eligible must be true, false or null.
Null values indicate that human review is required.
